final: WITH per_project AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM per_project), shares AS (SELECT arcref, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share FROM per_project CROSS JOIN total), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT shares.arcref, shares.record_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.avg_share AS deviation FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
